# Dear ImGui

Unmodified files from Dear ImGui 1.92.9b by Omar Cornut and contributors,
**MIT** licensed (`LICENSE.txt`).

- Source: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/archive/refs/tags/v1.92.9b.zip
  (SHA-256
  `e1c46d676c2bcb7ced847ba27f50553e33a19db97b3cadaec7f8be64449139f8`).
- Used by `gui/` (`igs-loader-gui`): the core, `backends/` Win32 + OpenGL3
  (Windows) and SDL2 + OpenGL3 (Linux), `misc/cpp/imgui_stdlib`.

Only the files needed for that are included.
